# SelfHostLab
> Self-hosted apps measured on a real VPS (RAM, CPU, disk), with reproducible commands.
- [n8n self-hosted requirements, measured](https://selfhostlab.org/n8n-self-hosted-requirements/): n8n 2.35.7 uses 555-850 MB RAM idle, 780 MB peak at 1,000 webhook runs with 10 in parallel; 2 GB minimum, 4 GB with PostgreSQL.
- [n8n Cloud vs self-hosted cost calculator](https://selfhostlab.org/n8n-cloud-vs-self-hosted-cost/): cloud plan by monthly executions (Starter 2,500 at 20 EUR/mo, Pro 10,000 at 50 EUR/mo, annual billing) vs 4-year VPS cost with renewal.
- [Ollama on a VPS without GPU, measured](https://selfhostlab.org/ollama-vps/): Ollama 0.40.17 on 4 AMD EPYC vCPU: Llama 3.2 1B 27.7 tok/s, 3B 21.1 tok/s, Llama 3.1 8B 9.0 tok/s (Q4_K_M, 5.4 GB RAM); 8 vCPU adds little (memory bandwidth bound); 8 GB VPS minimum for 8B.
